rationale: Correct the sole IATP record to show its 50/50 InfraBridge and Invenergy ownership. Keep InfraBridge active through legacy GIF II while its signed sale of that 50% interest to ArcLight remains pending, add Invenergy Clean Power as the continuing 50% owner and operator, and keep DigitalBridge only as the parent organization behind the InfraBridge record. No legal closing of the ArcLight acquisition was identified through August 19, 2026.

beforeImage.name: Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power
beforeImage.description: Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power is a portfolio of dispatchable thermal generation assets operated by Invenergy. The business serves competitive wholesale power markets through an asset-heavy portfolio of generation plants rather than through regulated distribution operations. InfraBridge currently owns a 50% stake through the legacy AMP Capital Global Infrastructure Fund II (GIF II) strategy, with Invenergy retaining the other 50% and operational role. ArcLight announced a definitive agreement in March 2026 to acquire InfraBridge's 50% stake, but the transaction remains subject to regulatory approvals and was expected to close in the second half of 2026.

afterImage.name: Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power
afterImage.description: Invenergy AMPCI Thermal Power LLC is a 50/50 joint venture that owns a portfolio of dispatchable power-generation assets across the United States and Canada. InfraBridge holds one half through the legacy AMP Capital Global Infrastructure Fund II strategy, and Invenergy Clean Power holds the other half and continues to operate and manage the portfolio. Public materials report 11 facilities totaling approximately 5.4 GW gross and 3.2 GW net. On March 12, 2026, ArcLight signed an agreement to acquire InfraBridge's 50% interest through disclosed Gray Wolf acquisition vehicles. Regulatory reviews advanced, but no FERC approval, consummation notice or party closing release was identified through August 19, 2026; InfraBridge therefore remains the current legal owner and ArcLight remains a pending incoming buyer.
